Part of the [pycyxwiz API reference](index.md), pycyxwiz 0.2.0: each name with the signature and description the module itself reports. Types are shown without the `pycyxwiz.` prefix; `Sequence[int]` is any list or tuple of integers. Use it as `pycyxwiz.timeseries.<name>` after `import pycyxwiz`.

Time series analysis functions

## Functions

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `acf(data: Sequence[float], max_lag: int = -1) -> dict` | Autocorrelation function |
| `add_features(data: Sequence[float], lag_values: Sequence[int] = [], rolling_windows: Sequence[int] = [], add_diff: bool = False) -> list[list[float]]` | Add engineered time-series features |
| `arima(data: Sequence[float], horizon: int, p: int = -1, d: int = -1, q: int = -1) -> dict` | ARIMA forecasting |
| `chronological_split(num_samples: int, train_ratio: float = 0.7, val_ratio: float = 0.15) -> tuple[int, int]` | Chronological train/val/test split |
| `create_multivariate_windows(data: Sequence[Sequence[float]], target_col: int, config: timeseries.WindowConfig) -> timeseries.WindowResult` | Create multivariate sliding windows |
| `create_windows(data: Sequence[float], config: timeseries.WindowConfig) -> timeseries.WindowResult` | Create sliding windows for ML |
| `decompose(data: Sequence[float], period: int, method: str = 'additive') -> dict` | Time series decomposition |
| `diff(data: Sequence[float], order: int = 1) -> list[float]` | Difference series |
| `pacf(data: Sequence[float], max_lag: int = -1) -> list[float]` | Partial autocorrelation function |
| `rolling_mean(data: Sequence[float], window: int) -> list[float]` | Rolling mean |
| `rolling_std(data: Sequence[float], window: int) -> list[float]` | Rolling standard deviation |
| `stationarity(arg0: Sequence[float]) -> dict` | Test for stationarity (ADF + KPSS) |
